summary: Added a manual final security readiness command for the remaining supply-chain blockers.

changes.reason: Provide a single blocking readiness check that reports missing package-lock.json, missing npm-audit.json, remaining floating dependency specs, unresolved npm audit vulnerabilities, and package manager pin drift.
Expose the readiness checker as npm run security:final-readiness without adding it to security:ci while current blockers remain expected.
Guard the new readiness command so it is not removed or retargeted without the supply-chain policy gate noticing.
Document the manual readiness gate, expected blockers, promotion criteria, and operational checklist placement.

status: Manual final readiness gate added; not promoted into security:ci yet because lockfile, npm-audit.json, and exact audited dependency versions are still pending external npm/GitHub Actions execution.
next: Generate package-lock.json with npm run supply-chain:lockfile using npm@10.8.2.
Generate or download npm-audit.json and run npm run security:npm-audit:summary.
Replace remaining floating dependency specs with exact audited versions.
Run npm run security:final-readiness and promote it into CI only after blockers are cleared.
